cards.text: Israel has just fought a war against Benjamin, one of its own tribes, and 600 Benjamite men escaped to the rock of Rimmon (Judges 20:47). Israel burned down the cities in their path (Judges 20:48). And back at Mizpah, the men of Israel had sworn an oath about Benjamin.

cards.question: What did the men of Israel swear back at Mizpah?

answers.text: Not one of us will give his daughter to a Benjamite
Not one of us will set foot on Benjamite land
Not one of us will ever trade with a Benjamite

cards.text: So the people come to Bethel and sit before God until evening, lifting up their voices and weeping bitterly. They won, and NOBODY is celebrating.

cards.question: Weeping before God at Bethel, what do the people ask the LORD?

answers.text: Why one tribe is missing from Israel
Why the battle took three whole days
Why Benjamin refused to hand anyone over

cards.text: Next day they're up early, building an altar and presenting burnt offerings and peace offerings. Then the Israelites ask: who among all the tribes of Israel didn't come to the assembly before the LORD?

cards.question: Israel had taken a solemn oath about anyone who failed to come up before the LORD at Mizpah. That person would surely face ___.

cards.text: And the Israelites grieve for their brothers, the Benjamites. They say, “Today a tribe is cut off from Israel.”

cards.question: Grieving for Benjamin, the Israelites ask what they should do about ___ for the survivors.

cards.text: They've sworn by the LORD not to give the survivors their daughters. So they ask again which tribe failed to come up before the LORD at Mizpah.

cards.question: When the people are counted, which town had nobody at the assembly?

cards.text: Then the congregation sends 12,000 of their most valiant men to Jabesh-gilead, commanding them to put those living there to the sword, including women and children. Every male, and every woman who has had relations with a man, is to be devoted to destruction.

cards.question: Among the people of Jabesh-gilead, the men find ___ young women who had not had relations with a man, and bring them to the camp at Shiloh.

cards.text: Then the whole congregation sends a message of peace to the Benjamites at the rock of Rimmon.

cards.question: The Benjamites return and are given the women spared from Jabesh-gilead. True or false: there are enough women for all of them.

cards.text: The people grieve for Benjamin, because the LORD had made a void in the tribes of Israel. Then the elders ask: what do we do about wives for the ones who remain, since the women of Benjamin have been destroyed?

cards.question: The elders say there must be ___ for the survivors of Benjamin, so that a tribe of Israel won't be wiped out.

cards.text: But the elders say they can't give them their own daughters, because the Israelites had sworn, “Cursed is he who gives a wife to a Benjamite.” They are STUCK, friend.
Then the elders say, “But look,” and start giving directions: north of Bethel, east of the road up to Shechem, south of Lebonah. Friend, that's not directions, that's a dropped pin.

cards.question: The elders point to a spot north of Bethel, east of the road up to Shechem and south of Lebonah. What happens there every year?

answers.text: A feast to the LORD in Shiloh
A meeting of the elders of Israel
A market for traders from every tribe

cards.question: For the feast at Shiloh, where do the elders tell the Benjamites to go and hide?
Hiding in the vineyards near Shiloh, what are the Benjamites told to watch for?

answers.text: The daughters of Shiloh coming out to dance
The priests of Shiloh coming out to pray
The fathers of Shiloh heading out to the road

cards.text: When they see them, each Benjamite is to come out of the vineyards and catch a wife for himself.

cards.question: True or false: once each Benjamite has caught a wife at Shiloh, the elders tell him to stay and settle in Shiloh.

cards.text: The elders even have a speech ready for the fathers or brothers who come to complain. They'll ask them to do the elders a favor by helping the Benjamites.

cards.question: The elders' reasoning: since the fathers didn't actually ___ their daughters to the Benjamites, they have no guilt.

cards.text: And the Benjamites do as instructed. They carry away the number of women they need from the dancers they catch.

cards.question: True or false: the Benjamites go back to their own inheritance, rebuild their cities and settle in them.
With the Benjamites settled again, where does each of the other Israelites go?

answers.text: Back to his own tribe and inheritance
Up to Shiloh for the yearly feast
Down to Mizpah for another assembly

cards.text: And the book of Judges ends with this: “In those days there was no king in Israel; everyone did what was right in his own eyes.”
